column1: # The engine's Insight managers and their class registration thunks.
# `main` (the game's main) constructs three managers, one per class: it runs the class's
# static init and then `igMetaObject_CreateInstance(<Class> MetaObject, owner)`.  The class is
# recovered from both ends -- the `_Register` function the thunk tail-calls and the MetaObject
# the `_GetMetaObject` accessors call when the class is not yet registered.
